description: Bridge between ELIZA-µ's deterministic field-ranked candidate (from eliza.field + eliza.rule, Ch'en accumulator) and the aiml.srai.vector block. Takes the Ch'en accumulator, extracts the AIML candidate, checks for <srai> in its template, and returns a typed routing proposal for XCFE verification. Turns ELIZA from an isolated Micronaut into a reusable semantic operator inside the K'UHUL Atomic workflow system.

operations.description: Receive Ch'en accumulator from eliza.rule (Yax) fold. Confirm status is pending_verification before proceeding.
Inspect candidate template for <srai>...</srai> tags. If present, extract srai_target text with wildcard_captures substituted.
If srai_target detected, delegate to aiml.srai.vector block for EMBED→RETRIEVE→FILTER→RANK→SRAI chain. If no srai_target, candidate is terminal — wrap directly into routing proposal.
Emit a typed routing proposal. XCFE must verify before Xul template_fill proceeds. Proposal may resolve to: a Micronaut capability, an atomic pipeline entry, a workflow block, or a direct template.

srai_route.resolved_to: string | null — resolved pattern after vector chain

routing_target.type: one of: direct_template | micronaut_capability | atomic_pipeline | workflow_block

xcfe_invariants: eliza.reflect (Xul template_fill) MUST NOT execute unless routing_proposal status is xcfe_admitted
gramWrite keys (eliza:last_response, eliza:active_field, eliza:match_score) are gated by principal and memory scope — not automatically authorized by proposal admission
field_score computation (default_bias * pattern_match_score) is data_only — ranking evidence must be preserved in provenance, not promoted to fact
